description: Create or preview a GitHub PR with a MartinLoop dossier body. Use execute=true to actually call gh.
name: martin_create_pr

body.description: GitHub-flavoured Markdown PR body containing the run dossier.

branch.description: Current branch of the run's repository, when known.

created.description: Whether a pull request was created.

execute.description: Whether gh was asked to create the pull request.

grade.description: Verification grade assigned to the run.

loopId.description: MartinLoop run identifier used to generate the summary.

url.description: URL of the created pull request.
